plugins.name: site-hardening
plugins.description: Check a website you own for the files and routes scanners look for (.env, keys, Amplify/Supabase/Terraform config, source maps, path traversal, auth bypass, security headers), build a verified Content-Security-Policy from what the site loads, and fix the rest.

plugins.name: fusionleap-ai-sdlc
plugins.description: Pre-commit security checks (Husky, lint-staged, tsc, detect-secrets, Semgrep) and spec-driven development (machine-readable specs, Claude-drafted tests, docs and scaffolds) for Node.js / TypeScript projects.

plugins.name: site-ops
plugins.description: Day-to-day operations for a small production website (Next.js on AWS Amplify, Vercel or Netlify): email DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX), pre- and post-deploy checks, fake crawler detection from access logs, AI visibility (robots, llms.txt, Organization schema), a test lead through your own form, and a weekly ops digest.

plugins.name: security-review-packet
plugins.description: Draft the packet security and compliance need before they sign off on an AI system: inventory of models, vendors, data stores, routes, agent tools, MCP servers, IaC and dependencies from the repo, then a cited system overview, data flow, data classification, threat review and open questions, with an optional SOC 2 / NIST AI RMF / ISO 42001 / OWASP LLM coverage map.

plugins.name: ai-necessity-gate
plugins.description: Run a proposed AI use case through the AI Necessity Gate before money is spent: would rules, search or a report do it instead, is the value measurable, and can the data be trusted. Profiles a data sample or schema without printing values, maps risk and sign-off, and writes a one-page verdict (Go, Go after fixing data, Not AI, Not yet) with scores.

plugins.name: agent-evals
plugins.description: Test an AI agent or LLM app before shipping and on every change: your own cases plus built-in suites for off-topic requests, prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage and destructive tool calls. Deterministic checks first, optional model-graded rubrics, repeats for flaky behaviour, and run-to-run comparison for CI.
